result.title: 電子發票消費熱度排名年統計
result.description: 以全年各縣市、鄉鎮市區、村里為單位計算電子發票消費發票張數、金額或雙月(或每月)營業稅申報銷售額、申報發票字軌起迄估算發票張數，並轉換為張數排名值、銷售額排名值等不透漏營業人營業資訊細節等方式呈現區域的消費排名值。

en.title: The statistical ranking of the popularity of electronic invoice consumption.
en.description: Calculate the number of electronic invoice consumption invoices, amounts, or sales amounts on a monthly basis for every county, city, township, and village, and estimate the number of invoices for double months (or every month) for the declaration of sales amount and invoice number range, and convert them into ranking values for number of invoices and sales amount to present the regional consumption ranking without revealing detailed business information of the business operator in any way.
en.notes: Authorization Description URL: http://data.gov.tw/licenseMinistry of Finance Financial Information Center Electronic Invoice Group OAS Standard API Documentation: https://www.einvoice.nat.gov.tw/portal/ods/openapi.json

resources.description: Calculate the number and amount of electronic invoice consumption invoices in various counties and cities, townships, and villages throughout the year, or estimate the number of invoices from the beginning to the end of the invoice track for every two months (or monthly) sales tax declaration sales, and convert them into ranking values for the number of invoices, sales, and other ways to present the regional consumption ranking value without revealing detailed business information of the busines
